turn.user_message: Why must discharge be built first?
turn.context: From bed-management.md §7.4.1 (c) the discharge linkage as a double control and (e) call-in timing, and §7.4.2 (discharge is a prerequisite), with the Nagpur bill and dead bed time figures.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Automations, turn 3 (the record stops at 31)

text: The bed plan runs on discharge times. If those times are guesses, the plan is a guess too.
bullets: Discharge is built first so its times are real. They are logged as they happen, not reported later.
The bed side then works backwards. It calls each patient in to arrive as their bed frees.
Once linked, each side checks the other. A reported time that does not match the bed shows at once.
